result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection on a multi-lane one-way street with well-maintained sidewalks and street trees. However, the complete absence of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals at a controlled crossing creates a high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection in the foreground across the one-way street

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signals are visible, which can lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Signal poles at the intersection corners

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parking
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side are positioned close to the intersection, potentially blocking sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway near the corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian crossing area and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on the remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The environment features a wide, well-maintained sidewalk adjacent to a mixed-use building, but lacks basic crossing infrastructure at the intersection. The presence of a childcare center suggests high pedestrian demand, yet there are no marked crosswalks or visible traffic control devices to protect people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at an intersection adjacent to a childcare facility increases the risk of pedestrian-vehicle conflicts.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, mid-ground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve sight lines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sight lines.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide roadway with a buffered bike lane and a signalized intersection. While sidewalks, street lighting, and pedestrian signals are present, the lack of marked crosswalks across the main thoroughfare and the presence of a wide gas station entrance create significant conflict points for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The absence of high-visibility crosswalk markings at a signalized intersection reduces driver awareness of pedestrian crossing points.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area across the main road.

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Conflict
hazards.description: The wide, uncontrolled entrance to the gas station creates a large conflict zone where turning vehicles may cross the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the gas station entrance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings across all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the gas station entrance to slow turning vehicles and minimize the pedestrian exposure area.

result.summary: This intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, despite being controlled by traffic lights for vehicles.
